blocks.orig: The Manyara Best View Lodge near Lake Manyara National Park is the perfect place for a day of rest in between safaris. You can spend the whole day at the infinity pool in the lodge, and enjoy the good service and amazing views. Or you go out and about and discover the many things you can do in the near vicinity – go mountain biking, visit a local market, hike along the Great Rift Valley wall or the lake, or go on a night game drive. The choice is yours!
blocks.html: For a rest day between safaris, Manyara Best View Lodge close to Lake Manyara National Park is an ideal choice. You can stay by the lodge's infinity pool all day long, enjoying the good service and the stunning views. Or you can head out and explore the many activities close by – ride a mountain bike, browse a local market, hike along the lake or the wall of the Great Rift Valley, or join a night game drive. It is up to you!
